explanation: Retrospective detector of a token that closes a tight unit opened by the token just before it, active (>~0.45 of max) in any register and any subject person: (1) the final suffix subword of a word the tokenizer splits into stem + suffix (Efferves|cent, Fires|ide, pharmac|ist, prot|racted, unwield|y, 0.45-1.0); (2) 'more' straight after 'some' or 'one' ('some more bread', 'one more chance', ~0.5-0.6); (3) a pronoun quantity after 'don't have' ('don't have one/any', ~0.6-0.7); (4) indirect-object 'you'/'us' right after 'give/gave/send' or subject 'you' after 'Can/Could' (~0.45-0.7), plus 'for' in 'Thanks for', 'about' in 'brought about', 'interest' in 'lot/lack of interest', and the copula in 'It was'. Predicted inactive (<~0.4): the same words outside these pairings - 'more' after a verb, 'far', 'for' or 'many' ('wanted more time', 'asked for more cake'), number words after a verb or preposition ('have three cars'; 'the two/three' is borderline 0.3-0.5), 'you' after a preposition or 'told', 'him'/'them' after any verb, single-token words ('tourist', 'dentist', 'Penguin'), digits, and plain prose.
